draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: T1.r1.bleu=28.4±0.6, T1.r2.bleu=27.6±0.8; S2 paired t-test p=0.017, CI [0.2,1.44], significant. Claim of slight outperformance is supported and appropriately scoped to the test set.
